title: Saint Francis Xavier
html_source:
Saint Francis Xavier is the co-patron saint of Navarre, an autonomous community in Northern Spain. He was the right hand man of St. Ignatius of Loyola and one of six other companions who began the Society of Jesus.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t3erLl7cTTI

The Day of Navarre in Spain marks the anniversary of Saint Francis Xavier’s death on December 3, 1552. The other co-patron of Navarre, Saint Fermin, is honored in Spain with the more exciting and famous Running of the Bulls festival.
